manifest.selection: Short model selected from prior pilot. Reused cargo combinations; confirmation, not a new unseen-cargo test.
manifest.design: Three independent process starts with original seed, plus two distinct seeds; both short_model and zero-mean control on all three cargos and two routes. No parameter updates or retraining. All outcomes retained.
manifest.runtime: Three concurrent processes with isolated ROS domains 94-96. Fixed-step simulation time excludes paused inference. Same-seed runs need not be bitwise identical.

zero_equivalence.proof: Restart eligibility requires measured offset <=4 mm. Both calibrations have every group margin <1 mm. With zero mean, all identical candidates are feasible and rank only by identical end speed. Other guards, observations and memory updates are identical. Therefore both zero-mean policies choose identical commands for the study; verified by replay of every zero-control trace.
zero_equivalence.caveat: Equivalence is specific to these margins and the current <=4 mm restart gate. Does not establish safety or equivalence of nonzero predictors.

caveats: Repeated known evaluation cargos, not independent unseen-cargo validation.
Only two routes and three cargos; one simulator/runtime; no hardware guarantee.
Stopped trials excluded from time means but retained in arrival counts and slip statistics.
Same-seed numerical/process variability and seed effects are not separated causally.
